equation_summary: ReBased applies a squared-dot polynomial feature map: the parallel kernel uses attn = (q.k)^2 (causal-masked), o = attn@v, z = attn.sum(-1), output o/(z + eps). The layer applies an external RebasedFeatureMap (with optional gamma/beta/normalize) to q,k and then runs chunk_linear_attn(normalize=True, scale=1) or parallel_rebased(use_normalize=True). There is no decay (G=I); the mixer is normalized linear attention with a polynomial feature map.
state_shape: [B,H,K_feat,V] matrix (expanded feature-dim state); plus a denominator cumulative state
